# website-templates

<a name="applyWebsiteTemplate"></a>

## applyWebsiteTemplate(plan, id, options) ⇒

Applies a website's structural starting point without changing client-owned styling.

**Kind**: global function
**Returns**: A separate document, ready for the provider's revision and autosave boundary.

| Param   | Description                                                             |
| ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| plan    | Current document; never mutated.                                        |
| id      | Catalog identifier received from a card, file, or validated URL intent. |
| options | Fresh plans receive the selected template's editable sample copy.       |
